items.html: And afterward the holy Atzilut was corrected, and then Keter and Hochma were corrected in the head of AA, in all those corrections, which are: in the skull and in the brain, which are in Keter and Hochma, and likewise in the whole existence of AA. And afterward the world of Atzilut was corrected with a complete correction. And after the world of Atzilut was corrected, all the Klipot were without any correction at all, absolutely.
